_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY (2026-11-21), NOT VERIFIED ON THE LIMO. Commands copied from fleet_control/scripts/limo_run.sh (motor lock = launch default, allow_motor_drive stays false). Copy to ~/.config/limo_fleet/supervisor.json on the robot after owner review; replace <SERVER> with the central Fleet Server URL. The web can only start/stop/restart/retry these named services; it can never change a command.

services.name: stack
services.cmd: export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=77 ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1; exec ros2 launch limo_capstone limo_integrated_auto_mapping_real.launch.py scan_normalizer:=true

services.name: watchdog
services.cmd: export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=77 ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1; exec python3 -m limo_robot_agent.motion_watchdog

services.name: agent
services.cmd: export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=77 ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1; exec ros2 run limo_robot_agent robot_agent --ros-args -p server_url:=http://<SERVER>:8080 -p token_file:=$HOME/.config/limo_fleet/agent-pcu.token -p robot_id:=pcu -p mode:=real -p simulated:=false -p allow_missions:=false
